name: DefenderForIdentity PowerShell module – prove MDI auditing, SACLs and sensor connectivity
what: Microsoft's PowerShell module for Defender for Identity post-deployment configuration. `New-MDIConfigurationReport` writes an HTML + JSON report of the domain's MDI-relevant SACLs and audit GPOs; `Test-MDIConfiguration`/`Get-MDIConfiguration` check individual settings (AdvancedAuditPolicyDCs/CAs, NTLMAuditing, DomainObjectAuditing, ConfigurationContainerAuditing, AdfsAuditing, CAAuditing, EntraConnectAuditing, RemoteSAM, ProcessorPerformance, AdRecycleBin); `Set-MDIConfiguration` creates the GPOs; `Test-MDISensorApiConnection` checks the sensor-to-cloud path including proxy.
when: Before trusting MDI detections as purple-team evidence, after DC builds or GPO clean-ups, and now that the classic remote-execution and pass-the-hash alerts retire (end of November 2026): the replacement custom detections run on IdentityDirectoryEvents, which only contains what the sensors can see. Run the read-only report in every domain and keep it with the detection-coverage record.
cost_note: Version 1.0.0.5 on the PowerShell Gallery (6 March 2026). Requires Windows PowerShell 5.1 or PowerShell 7.4+ (with `Import-Module GroupPolicy -SkipEditionCheck`). MDI itself needs its own licence.
example: Install for the current user: `Install-Module DefenderForIdentity -Scope CurrentUser`.
Read-only domain report: `New-MDIConfigurationReport -Path C:\Reports\MDI -Mode Domain -OpenHtmlReport` (add `-GpoNamePrefix <prefix>` if your GPOs follow a naming convention).
Check one setting across the domain: `Test-MDIConfiguration -Mode Domain -Configuration NTLMAuditing,AdvancedAuditPolicyDCs`.
On a sensor server: `Test-MDISensorApiConnection` (or `-BypassConfiguration -SensorApiUrl <url> -SensorType Classic -ProxyUrl <proxy>` to test a planned proxy).
Only after change approval: `Set-MDIConfiguration -Mode Domain -Configuration All -Identity <gMSA> -CreateGpoDisabled -SkipGpoLink -WhatIf`, then link and enable deliberately.
pitfalls: `Set-MDIConfiguration` creates and (by default) links GPOs and changes SACLs on the domain — run it with `-WhatIf`, `-CreateGpoDisabled` and `-SkipGpoLink` first, under change control.
A green report covers MDI prerequisites, not endpoint coverage: pass-the-hash detection after the classic alert retirement depends on Defender for Endpoint being onboarded on the relevant hosts.
The report reflects the GPOs it can find by name; custom-named audit GPOs show as missing unless you pass the right `-GpoNamePrefix`.
Run it only in domains you administer or have written authorisation to assess.
